mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.student_id, p.class_code, p.current_page, p.is_submitted, p.last_heartbeat, s.student_name, s.student_no FROM biz_guide_sheet_progress p LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id WHERE p.sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND p.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY p.last_heartbeat DESC

SELECT p.id, p.student_id, p.class_code, p.current_page, p.is_submitted, p.last_heartbeat, s.student_name, s.student_no FROM biz_guide_sheet_progress p LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id WHERE p.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY p.class_code, s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_guide_sheet_progress (sheet_id, student_id, class_code, current_page, is_submitted, last_heartbeat) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{studentId}, #{classCode}, #{currentPage}, #{isSubmitted}, #{lastHeartbeat}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_page = VALUES(current_page), is_submitted = VALUES(is_submitted), last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat)
